messages.subject: Histogram with different color fillings
parts:
Hi,

I am working on a histogram where certain regions (based on quantiles)
have different colors. I found on this discussion list an answer how
to do this with two different regions, using a logical statement for
fill. How could I this with multiple?

An example
df <- data.frame(x=rnorm(10000))
g <- ggplot(data=df, aes(x=x))
g <- g + geom_histogram()
print(g)

I would like to fill the histogram with different colors for these
regions (for example) (-Inf, -2], (-2,2], and (2, Inf).

Thanks so much.
T

messages.author: 92a06be4d96a96ee
messages.subject: Re: Histogram with different color fillings
parts:
take a look at ?cut.


ggplot(df,aes(x=x,fill=cut(x,c(-Inf,-2,2,Inf))))+geom_histogram()

or assign the cuts to a new column of the data frame

df$cuts <- cut(df$x,c(-Inf,-2,2,Inf))

ggplot(df,aes(x=x,fill=cuts))+geom_histogram()
